pages.quiz:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'the father' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la grand-mère
   B. la sœur
   C. le bébé
   D. le père

2. Which number is vingt-deux? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 20
   D. 22

3. How do you write the number 15 in French? (1 mark)
   A. treize
   B. quinze
   C. vingt
   D. huit

4. How do you say 'On Saturday, I help my mother.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le jeudi, je chante.
   B. Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.
   C. Une semaine, sept jours.
   D. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.

5. What does 'De rien' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Go
   B. You are welcome
   C. Turn
   D. Excuse me

6. What does 'la télé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the sofa
   B. the kitchen
   C. the TV
   D. the window

7. How do you say the month 'August' in French? (1 mark)
   A. avril
   B. novembre
   C. août
   D. septembre

8. How do you say 'I play' in French? (1 mark)
   A. je joue
   B. je chante
   C. je me repose
   D. demain

9. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'baby'? (1 mark)
   A. bébé
   B. bèbé
   C. bebe
   D. béé

10. How do you say 'to the left' in French? (1 mark)
   A. à gauche
   B. à côté de
   C. tout droit
   D. près de

11. How do you say 'I sing' in French? (1 mark)
   A. demain
   B. je chante
   C. je me repose
   D. hier

12. How do you say 'the mouth' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la dent
   B. la bouche
   C. le pied
   D. la jambe

13. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'Pleased to meet you'? (1 mark)
   A. Enchnté
   B. Enchanté
   C. Enchante
   D. Enchantè

14. What does 'le grand-père' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the grandfather
   B. the father
   C. the child
   D. the grandmother

15. What does 'Comment tu t'appelles ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. And you?
   B. Hello, Amina!
   C. Good evening, Madam!
   D. What is your name?

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: 'Il y a des nuages.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Translate into French: 'It is hot.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

18. Translate into English: 'Oui, ça va.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

19. Translate into French: 'It is snowing.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

20. Translate into French: 'Here is a present for you.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

21. Explain why the order le 12 mai matters and write the date the wrong way for comparison. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — le père
   the father in French is le père.

2. D — 22
   Vingt is 20 and deux is 2.

3. B — quinze
   15 in French is quinze.

4. B — Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.
   On Saturday, I help my mother. in French is Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.

5. B — You are welcome
   De rien means You are welcome.

6. C — the TV
   la télé means the TV.

7. C — août
   August in French is août.

8. A — je joue
   I play in French is je joue.

9. A — bébé
   The correct spelling is bébé, with its accents.

10. A — à gauche
   to the left in French is à gauche.

11. B — je chante
   I sing in French is je chante.

12. B — la bouche
   the mouth in French is la bouche.

13. B — Enchanté
   The correct spelling is Enchanté, with its accents.

14. A — the grandfather
   le grand-père means the grandfather.

15. D — What is your name?
   Comment tu t'appelles ? means What is your name?

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is cloudy.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Il fait chaud.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Yes, I am fine.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Il neige.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Voici un cadeau pour toi.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: In French the day comes first. The wrong way is mai le 12.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct order, 1 mark for the wrong example and 1 mark for the explanation.
